tech.q: Which language is mainly used to structure web pages?
tech.hint: It uses tags such as h1 and p.
tech.explanation: HTML defines the structure and content of web pages.

tech.q: Which keyword declares a block-scoped variable in JavaScript?
tech.hint: It has three letters and starts with l.
tech.explanation: The let keyword declares a block-scoped variable.

tech.hint: The first item added leaves first.
tech.explanation: A queue follows First In, First Out.

tech.q: What is the average lookup time in a well-distributed hash table?
tech.hint: It is constant time on average.
tech.explanation: Hash tables provide average-case O(1) lookup.

tech.q: Which protocol helps encrypt web traffic?
tech.hint: It is the secure version of HTTP.
tech.explanation: HTTPS uses TLS to protect data in transit.

gk.q: What is the capital of Japan?
gk.explanation: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.

gk.q: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
gk.hint: It lies between Asia and the Americas.
gk.explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean.

gk.q: How many days are there in a leap year?
Which Indian city is known as the Pink City?
gk.hint: It is the capital of Rajasthan.
gk.explanation: Jaipur is popularly known as the Pink City.

gk.q: Who wrote the Indian national anthem?
gk.hint: He was a Nobel Prize-winning poet.
gk.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore wrote Jana Gana Mana.

science.q: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
science.explanation: Iron oxides give Mars its reddish appearance.

science.q: What is the chemical formula for water?
science.explanation: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

science.q: What force pulls objects toward Earth?
science.hint: It keeps us on the ground.
science.explanation: Gravity attracts objects with mass toward one another.

science.q: Which organ pumps blood through the human body?
science.explanation: The heart pumps blood through the circulatory system.

science.q: What is the SI unit of electric current?
science.hint: It is named after André-Marie Ampère.
science.explanation: The ampere is the SI unit of electric current.

cyber.q: Which password practice is generally the strongest?
cyber.explanation: A long, unique password or passphrase is harder to guess.

cyber.explanation: MFA uses two or more different types of verification.

cyber.q: What is the main purpose of a firewall?
cyber.hint: It controls incoming and outgoing network connections.
cyber.explanation: A firewall filters network traffic according to security rules.
